markets.rules_primary: If the United States Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit vacates or reverses, in whole or in part and on any ground including ripeness, the preliminary injunction barring enforcement of Act 174 of 2024's foreign-ownership restrictions on digital asset mining businesses in Jones Eagle LLC v. Ward before Feb 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The ruling must:
Be issued by the United States Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit in Jones Eagle LLC v. Ward
Address the matter described by the specified judgment
Be issued through a written order, opinion, judgment, or decision

The following do NOT satisfy the Payout Criterion:
Oral rulings from the bench unless reduced to a written order
Tentative rulings that are not made final
Draft opinions that leak but are not officially issued
Settlements or voluntary dismissals
Administrative or scheduling orders
Orders to show cause
Minute orders that do not address the substantive issue in the specified judgment

For clarity:
If the case is dismissed for lack of jurisdiction, that counts as a ruling only if the judgment refers to jurisdiction
Sua sponte rulings count if they match the specified judgment
Per curiam opinions and summary orders count as rulings
If multiple judges issue separate opinions, the majority/plurality opinion controls
markets.title: Will the United States Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit rule vacates or reverses, in whole or in part and on any ground including ripeness, the preliminary injunction barring enforcement of Act 174 of 2024's foreign-ownership restrictions on digital asset mining businesses?

markets.rules_primary: If exactly 2 members of the Senate Republicans lose re-election in 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary: Members count as losing re-election if they actively seek re-election (by filing candidacy or appearing on ballot) but fail to win. This includes losses in primaries, general elections, runoffs, retention elections, or recalls. Members who retire, withdraw before primaries, die, resign, or are disqualified do not count as losses. If redistricting forces two group members against each other, the loser counts. Members who switch parties after issuance remain part of the original group. If a member loses their party primary but wins as an independent, they did not lose re-election.
markets.title: Will exactly 2 the Senate Republicans lose re-election in 2026?

markets.rules_primary: If the U.S. dollar’s share of international payments by value on Swift, excluding payments within the Eurozone, for December 2026 is above 59.0%, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The Underlying is the percentage share attributed to USD for December 2026 in the “International payments currency - Excluding payments within Eurozone” table published by Swift in its Global Currency Tracker. The statistic is based on the value of live and delivered MT 103, MT 202, and equivalent ISO 20022 payment messages exchanged on Swift, including customer-initiated and institutional payments.

This market will use the first value published by Swift for December 2026. Corrections or revisions published after Expiration will not be considered.

If Swift changes the title, format, or location of the Global Currency Tracker but continues to publish a materially equivalent statistic, the corresponding successor publication may be used.
markets.title: Will U.S. dollar’s share of international payments by value on Swift, excluding payments within the Eurozone for December 2026 be above 59.0%?
